question: Which of the following is a Ramsar wetland site located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chilika Lake**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chilika Lake** is a massive **brackish water lagoon** spread over the **Puri, Khurda, and Ganjam** districts of **Odisha** state on the east coast of India.
 
• In **1981**, **Chilika Lake** was designated as the **first Indian wetland of international importance** under the **Ramsar Convention**, alongside Keoladeo National Park. ***Hence, the option is correct.***
 
• It is the **largest coastal lagoon** in India and the **second largest** in the world, following the New Caledonian barrier reef.
 
• The lake is home to the **Irrawaddy dolphin**, which is the only known population of these dolphins in India.
